title: Patreon fees explained
subtitle: What you keep, an example month, and how to start
sections: Payment processing: US card / Apple Pay 2.9% + $0.30; non-US PayPal 3.9% + $0.30; GBP/EUR 3.4% + 0.35.
2.5% currency conversion when a fan pays in a different currency.
One perk fans can't get free: bonus episodes, early access, a monthly live Q&A.
One tier to start. Add more only when asked.
steps: Mention it at the end of every video for a month.
